name: Release notes
description: "What's new" panel for a version: date and three optional lists (new, improved, fixed) under coloured labels.

params.name: date
params.help: Release date as shown, e.g. 24 Nov 2026 (empty: none)

params.name: new
params.help: New features, one short line each (empty: section hidden)

params.name: improved
params.help: Improvements, one short line each (empty: section hidden)

params.name: fixed
params.help: Fixes, one short line each (empty: section hidden). About 12 lines fit in all

new: Scenes: switch several layers at once

fixed: Stream key no longer asked twice
